messages:
Alice (Customer): Hi, we're seeing intermittent 500s on generate endpoint, happening ~10% of requests. Got a request_id: req_7b9c2f1a. Can you pull server logs? We need timestamps around 2026-03-12T14:23:10Z.
Maya (Support): Thanks Alice — pinging SRE. Can you confirm the exact request_id and region?
Alice (Customer): region=us-west-2, request_id=req_7b9c2f1a, sample curl: 
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"test","max_tokens":50}'

Maya (Support): Got it. Sam / @Ben - can someone search logs for request_id=req_7b9c2f1a? Alice, heads up: hosted customers' server-side request logs are kept 14 days by default; Dedicated customers can have longer retention.
Sam (SRE): I'll run a quick scan. For future lookups we use our internal log-search. Example lucene query: request_id:"req_7b9c2f1a" OR trace.id:"req_7b9c2f1a" AND @timestamp:[2026-03-12T14:20:00 TO 2026-03-12T14:30:00]
Sam (SRE): Running now... :spinner:
logbot: search job 34219 started by Sam
Sam (SRE): Found entries — looks like a downstream 502 from edge-proxy at 14:23:11. Extracts: upstream_tls_error, backend=embedder-2. Stack trace snippet: "grpc: transport is closing"
Ben (Eng): Hmm edge->embedder TLS renegotiation. Could you paste the full log lines? If they truncated, ask for debug bundle (we can attach network traces).
Maya (Support): Alice — can you collect a debug bundle with curl reproduction? Steps: 1) reproduce with header "X-Request-ID: req_7b9c2f1a" 2) record timestamps 3) send debug bundle via the support portal or reply 'UPLOAD' and we'll send secure upload link.
Alice (Customer): Will repro now and upload. Quick Q: is there any way we can run a log query ourselves?
Sam (SRE): We can share a short read-only kibana link but hosted accounts don't have direct access. For self-serve: use curl to query our log API (internal) — example:
curl -s "https://logs.redwood.ai/search?query=request_id%3A%22req_7b9c2f1a%22&from=2026-03-12T14:20:00&to=2026-03-12T14:30:00" -H "Authorization: Bearer <support-token>"
Ben (Eng): If logs are beyond retention we'll need S3 ingestion archives. For hosted, retention 14 days; if Alice's event is older we can pull from cold storage but it's a manual request.
Alice (Customer): Uploaded debug bundle (ID dbg-8822) via portal. Link: https://support.redwood.ai/attachments/dbg-8822
Maya (Support): Got it — attaching to the ticket and passing to Eng. Ben, Sam: requesting correlation with backend instance IDs from the bundle.
Ben (Eng): Copy. I'll correlate embedder-2 container logs with the debug bundle. Expect follow-up in ~45m.
Alice (Customer): Thanks, appreciate the quick help.
Maya (Support): :thumbsup: closing loop once eng confirms root cause (likely TLS renegotiation on embedder-2).
